text:
Denton Mateychuk is 22, playing almost 22 minutes a night for Columbus, and doing it with a shooter's instinct: four goals in 20 games. Columbus takes 52% of the five-on-five expected goals with him on (expected goals measure the quality of chances), five points better than without him, which makes him one of the Blue Jackets' better play drivers on a team under water.

His points, seven, trail the play. The team has scored about 2.2 fewer goals than its chances with him on the ice, and Evolving-Hockey had him with more expected wins than actual ones last season. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking puts him in the 95th percentile among defensemen for chances from in front of the net, rare for a blueliner, and 59% of his exits leave the zone with possession. He draws more penalties than he takes. The 12th overall pick of 2022, a Winnipeg native, he scored 17 goals in his last junior season with Moose Jaw. Our range has him around 32 points.
